lyrics.ja: 奇跡のような
lyrics.en: Like a miracle

lyrics.ja: キミと作るメモリー
lyrics.en: Memories I make with you

lyrics.ja: ギュッと握りしめ　願ったよ
lyrics.en: I held them tight and made a wish
lyrics.zh: 緊緊握在手中，許下了心願

lyrics.ja: きっと開花する　ワクワクの新芽
lyrics.romaji: Kitto Kaika Suru Wakuwaku no Shinme
lyrics.en: The exciting new buds will surely bloom
lyrics.zh: 令人興奮的新芽必定會綻放

lyrics.ja: この場所が初めての　紡ぐ道標
lyrics.romaji: Kono Basho ga Hajimete no Tsumugu Michishirube
lyrics.en: This place is the first guidepost we weave
lyrics.zh: 這個地方是初次編織的路標

lyrics.ja: ちょっとずつでも　踏み入れてみて
lyrics.en: Even little by little, try stepping in
lyrics.zh: 即使一點一點也好，試著踏進去

lyrics.ja: 幸せはすぐ傍にあるものだから
lyrics.romaji: Shiawase ha Sugu Soba ni Aru Mono Dakara
lyrics.en: Because happiness is right by your side

lyrics.ja: 怖がらないで　夢中になる
lyrics.en: Don't be afraid—become absorbed

lyrics.ja: その力を… For you
lyrics.en: That power... for you

lyrics.ja: この空に花咲かせてみせるよ
lyrics.romaji: Kono Sora ni Hana Sakasete Miseru yo
lyrics.en: I'll make flowers bloom in this sky
lyrics.zh: 我會讓花朵在這片天空綻放

lyrics.ja: 何よりも強い　生命(いのち)の息
lyrics.romaji: Nani yori mo Tsuyoi Inochi no Iki
lyrics.en: The breath of life, stronger than anything
lyrics.zh: 比什麼都強大的生命氣息

lyrics.ja: 涙は未来の味方になるから
lyrics.romaji: Namida ha Mirai no Mikata ni Naru kara
lyrics.en: Because tears will become allies of the future
lyrics.zh: 因為淚水會成為未來的助力

lyrics.ja: 隣で拭ってあげる
lyrics.en: I'll wipe them away by your side

lyrics.ja: 小さな幸せが積もる未来へ
lyrics.romaji: Chiisana Shiawase ga Tsumoru Mirai e
lyrics.en: Toward a future where small happiness piles up
lyrics.zh: 前往微小幸福層層累積的未來

lyrics.ja: La la…　口ずさむ安らぎは
lyrics.en: La la... The peace I hum

lyrics.ja: 足跡が語る　証の結晶で
lyrics.romaji: Ashiato ga Kataru Akashi no Kesshou de
lyrics.en: Is a crystal of proof told by our footprints
lyrics.zh: 是足跡述說的證明結晶

lyrics.ja: 次はキミが居るから
lyrics.romaji: Tsugi ha Kimi ga Iru kara
lyrics.en: Because next time, you'll be here

lyrics.ja: 希望は無限だね
lyrics.en: Hope is infinite, isn't it?

lyrics.ja: 一歩ずつから始めてみるよ
lyrics.romaji: Ippo Zutsu kara Hajimete Miru yo
lyrics.en: I'll try starting one step at a time

lyrics.ja: 一緒に過ごして宝物より尊い
lyrics.romaji: Issho ni Sugoshite Takaramono yori Toutoi
lyrics.en: Spending time together is more precious than treasure
lyrics.zh: 與你共度的時光比寶物更珍貴

lyrics.ja: 夢の続きを　叶えて行こう
lyrics.romaji: Yume no Tsuzuki wo Kanaete Ikou
lyrics.en: Let's go make the continuation of our dreams come true

lyrics.ja: 伝えて行こう…　With you
lyrics.en: Let's keep conveying it... with you

lyrics.ja: (I)　散らばった
lyrics.en: (I) Scattered

lyrics.ja: (You)　刻のカケラ
lyrics.en: (You) Fragments of time

lyrics.ja: たとえチグハグだって
lyrics.en: Even if they're mismatched

lyrics.ja: かき集めれば
lyrics.en: If we gather them up

lyrics.ja: ほら　新しいセカイ
lyrics.en: Look—a new world

lyrics.ja: 開くはずだから
lyrics.en: Should open up

lyrics.ja: 今日も明日も
lyrics.en: Today and tomorrow too

lyrics.ja: “ありがとう”　歌ってくよ
lyrics.en: I'll keep singing "thank you"

lyrics.ja: 鮮やかな花を咲かすために
lyrics.romaji: Azayaka na Hana wo Sakasu Tame ni
lyrics.en: In order to make vivid flowers bloom
lyrics.zh: 為了讓鮮豔的花朵盛開

lyrics.ja: 大空へ満開にしてみせるよ
lyrics.romaji: Oozora e Mankai ni Shite Miseru yo
lyrics.en: I'll make them fully bloom into the great sky
lyrics.zh: 會讓它們在廣闊天空盛放給你看

lyrics.ja: 何よりも強い　生命(いのち)の息
lyrics.romaji: Nani yori mo Tsuyoi Inochi no Iki
lyrics.en: The breath of life, stronger than anything
lyrics.zh: 比什麼都強大的生命氣息

lyrics.ja: 涙は巡って味方になるから
lyrics.romaji: Namida ha Megutte Mikata ni Naru kara
lyrics.en: Because tears will come around and become allies
lyrics.zh: 淚水終將繞了一圈成為助力

lyrics.ja: 隣で拭ってあげる
lyrics.en: I'll wipe them away by your side

lyrics.ja: 小さな幸せが積もる未来へ
lyrics.romaji: Chiisana Shiawase ga Tsumoru Mirai e
lyrics.en: Toward a future where small happiness piles up
lyrics.zh: 前往微小幸福層層累積的未來

lyrics.ja: 奇跡のような
lyrics.en: Like a miracle

lyrics.ja: キミと作るメモリー
lyrics.en: Memories I make with you
